sourceFindings.inspection: Exact 4 mm poplar is cut to size, but all six gallery originals, including the explicitly linked dvid=8 variants, return only 500 × 400 pixels. Query-free and dvid=8 files match byte-for-byte.

Search-indexed page confirms 4 mm beech with millimetre cut service, but direct page request returned HTTP 403 and exposed no original photo. Prior same source was also unavailable; no bypass or image substitution attempted.

Manufacturer lists 2520 × 1720 mm poplar at 4/6 mm thicknesses. The 1560 × 1043 XL gallery photograph instead shows a thick branded sample with many plies. It cannot represent the thin exact variants.
Category inspection led to exact 500 × 250 × 3/4 mm poplar pages, whose largest linked files are identical 800 × 800 cropped-corner photographs.

Custom-cut 4 mm poplar is offered in bounds covering 250 × 500 mm, but the 2560 × 1024 source is only a cropped corner with many visible plies. It is not a complete-sheet main; displayed thickness is not established independently.

Current product title says basswood 210 × 300 × 3 mm, whereas the URL and body also say Baltic birch. Main native files are 1000 × 1000. Larger files show engraved finished goods or promotional text, not additional exact raw-sheet views.
